name: Valley Vista Swiss Luxury Camp
shortDescription: Experience the Valley of Flowers in absolute comfort with attached baths, warm bedding, and gourmet local cuisine.
description: Nestled in Ghangaria, the gateway to Valley of Flowers, our Luxury Swiss Tents provide the perfect blend of wilderness adventure and premium hospitality. Recharge after a long trek in spacious tents equipped with premium wooden bedding, attached tiled washrooms, continuous hot water, and a cozy dining area offering local Garhwali delicacies.

itinerary.title: Arrival in Govindghat & Drive to Ghangaria Base camp
activities: Arrive at Govindghat early morning.
Meet the camp coordinator for brief orientation.
Start the scenic 14km trek or take a shared helicopter/mule to Ghangaria.
Welcome drink (local Rhododendron juice) upon check-in.
Evening bonfire with live local music and dinner.

itinerary.title: Trek to Valley of Flowers National Park
activities: Early morning breakfast at 6:30 AM.
Begin trek to Valley of Flowers (4km one way).
Spend 4-5 hours exploring the glacial streams and fields of blue poppies, primulas, and anemones.
Enjoy packed gourmet lunch inside the valley.
Return to camp by evening for warm soup and foot massages.

itinerary.title: Pilgrimage Trek to Sri Hemkund Sahib
activities: Hearty breakfast at the camp dining hall.
Embark on the challenging 6km trek to the holy Hemkund Sahib lake (4,632m altitude).
Take in views of the majestic Laxman temple and surrounding glaciers.
Enjoy hot langar (community kitchen) lunch at the Gurudwara.
Trek down to Ghangaria camp for hot towels and a celebratory farewell dinner.

itinerary.title: Ghangaria to Govindghat Departure
activities: Breakfast at the camp.
Trek or ride back down to Govindghat.
Group photo session and certificates distribution.
Board onward vehicles with memorable valley experiences.

meals: All meals included: Breakfast, Lunch, High Tea, and Buffet Dinner
Hot garlic soup served post-trek to prevent cold/mountain sickness
Traditional Garhwali meals (Koda ki Roti, Chainsoo, Mandua Kheer)
stay: Premium double-occupancy Swiss Cottage Tents with carpets, wooden furniture, and attached dry washrooms with hot water geysers.
inclusions: Welcome drinks and traditional Garhwali tikka welcome
Luxury Swiss Tent accommodation on twin sharing
Certified local trekking guide and naturalist companion
All park entry fees, permissions, and forest department clearances
First aid support, oxygen cylinders, and emergency stretcher service
exclusions: Mule, porter, or helicopter charges for personal luggage transport

name: Adventure Trekker's Dome Camp
shortDescription: Perfect for solo travelers and backpackers looking for a rustic, high-altitude alpine camping experience close to nature.
description: Get closer to the elements with our weather-proof adventure dome camps. Located on a scenic clearing just outside the Ghangaria village, these camps offer standard dual-sharing configurations with premium sleeping bags, insulated mats, and delicious meals served in a communal dome tent.

itinerary.title: Govindghat to Forest Camp Trek
activities: Assemble at Govindghat base point at 7:00 AM.
Scenic trek along the Pushpawati River to Ghangaria.
Check-in at the dome campsite under the pine forest canopy.
Briefing session on Leave No Trace camping principles.
Dinner around a cozy campfire.

itinerary.title: Full Day Floral Exploration in the Valley
activities: Pack your backpack with trekking rations.
Enter the Valley of Flowers National Park (UNESCO site).
Identify alpine flora with our local field expert.
Cross the log bridges and picnic by the stream.
Return to camp for hot tea and travel storytelling.

itinerary.title: Descent and Departure
activities: Breakfast at camp.
Descent trek to Govindghat.
Trip wraps up by 2:00 PM.

meals: Nutritious vegetarian meals: Breakfast, packed trail lunch, and simple dinner
Energy bars, nuts, and ORS packets provided for the treks
stay: High-altitude dual-layer 3-season dome tents with sub-zero sleeping bags (-10°C rated) and insulated ground sheets.
inclusions: Experienced trek leader and local guide
exclusions: Any porter service for personal backpacks

name: Valley Wilderness Eco Camp
shortDescription: Sustainable, zero-carbon footprint lodging that respects the local ecosystem while keeping costs affordable.
description: Our Eco Camps are built using sustainable canvas and local wood, avoiding any plastic waste. We offer cozy, shared community tents, bio-degradable toilets, and fresh organic food sourced from nearby village farms.

itinerary.title: Welcome and Eco Orientation
activities: Trek from Govindghat to Ghangaria Eco Camp.
Welcome drink made of wild berries.
Orientation on composting toilets and water conservation.
Organic dinner by the woodstove.

itinerary.title: Valley of Flowers Eco-Trail Trek
activities: Morning yoga and breathing exercises.
Trek to the Valley of Flowers.
Flora documenting and cleaning trail session (optional).
Organic soup dinner.

itinerary.title: Return Trek to Base
activities: Breakfast and checkout.
Descent trek to Govindghat.

meals: Herbal tea, ginger honey lemon water, and local snacks
stay: Shared family eco-cottage tents with thick warm wool blankets and common eco-toilets.
